Who we are

Senior expertise, focused on meaningful AI innovation.

Fabero Consulting is a boutique consulting firm specialised in digital strategy and AI innovation. It was founded by three senior consultants with over 60 years of combined experience in digital transformation, launch excellence, and customer engagement across Europe and globally.

Our mission is to help you understand where AI can make your processes more effective and efficient at moments with low tolerance for uncertainty, such as preparing for the international launch of a new product.

What we do

Move from opportunity to execution.

If you know AI could improve your business, but you’re not yet sure where to focus or how to scale, we enable your move from opportunity to execution with speed, rigor and transparency.

Together, we answer the questions that unlock progress.

Our goal is to help you move from ideas to results, quickly, yet with confidence and clarity.

Our approach

Solve the right problem before building the solution.

Introducing AI without understanding the real business problem and the organizational context bears the risk of low adoption, limited impact, or pilots that don’t scale.

Our Double-Diamond, human-orchestrated, innovation method reduces this risk.

Diamond 1

The right problem

Understand the context and frame the problem before solutions are generated.
